definitions.gloss: evacuation; taking shelter; retreat to safety
definitions.explanation: Moving away from a dangerous area or taking shelter to avoid harm. Used for both physical evacuation from disasters and moving out of the way of something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧な⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{退避|たいひ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To evacuate to a safe place.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}った→鳴る：01143_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{退避|たいひ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The alarm sounded, so we evacuated the building.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}づいている→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高台|たかだい}→高台：14683_takadai⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{退避|たいひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}められた→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Because a typhoon was approaching, residents were urged to evacuate to higher ground.

notes:
Moving to safety to avoid danger. Composed of {退|たい} (retreat) + {避|ひ} (avoid). Often used in disaster preparedness and emergency contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {退避|たいひ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to evacuate; to take shelter
- {退避|たいひ}⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧: evacuation site; shelter
- {退避|たいひ}⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：03754_meirei⟧: evacuation order
- {退避|たいひ}{勧告|かんこく}: evacuation advisory
- ⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧{退避|たいひ}: emergency evacuation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{避難|ひなん}→避難：07908_hinan⟧: evacuation, taking refuge — the most common general word for evacuation; used broadly for disasters, emergencies, and refugee situations
- ⟦{撤退|てったい}→撤退：12822_tettai⟧: withdrawal, retreat — primarily used in military or business contexts for pulling back from a position
- ⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧: to avoid — a verb meaning to dodge or avoid, not specifically about evacuation

USAGE:
{退避|たいひ} emphasizes moving away from immediate danger, while ⟦{避難|ひなん}→避難：07908_hinan⟧ is broader and includes taking refuge. In IT contexts, {退避|たいひ} can mean backing up data to a safe location.
